title: The Nashville Dollhouse
description:
Way down yonder in the land of pink rhinestones and feather wings, there was a wonderland of gold and pink magic called The Nashville Dollhouse. This was discovered to be the perfect place to get all dolled up and git your Yeehaw on! 

P.s. For events, photoshoots or filming, send us an inquiry first. Any reservation for events, photoshoots or filming without our consent will be immediately canceled and no refund will be issued.

The space
From the luxurious outdoor pink clawfoot soaker tub to the pink sandy beach mural magic corner, to the plush pink round king bed in a golden room, The Nashville Dollhouse has it all… like, literally… all.

Our sleeping arrangements goes as follows:
One 84" round bed in the master bedroom (sleeps 2)
One full bed in the 2nd bedroom (sleeps 2)
One twin bed with a trundle in the 3rd bedroom (sleeps 1 in each)
One couch in the living room (sleeps 1)

Guest access
Full house + front and side yard.

Other things to note
Our outdoor pink clawfoot tub has a fully functional shower that is on from March to early December. We turn the tub's water off during winter time.
